mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_learning_stat (stat_dim, dim_id, stat_date, watch_uv, finish_rate, avg_valid_duration, bounce_rate) VALUES (#{statDim}, #{dimId}, #{statDate}, #{watchUv}, #{finishRate}, #{avgValidDuration}, #{bounceRate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE watch_uv = VALUES(watch_uv), finish_rate = VALUES(finish_rate), avg_valid_duration = VALUES(avg_valid_duration), bounce_rate = VALUES(bounce_rate)
mapper.select: SELECT id, stat_dim, dim_id, stat_date, watch_uv, finish_rate, avg_valid_duration, bounce_rate FROM t_learning_stat WHERE stat_dim = #{statDim} AND dim_id = #{dimId} ORDER BY stat_date DESC LIMIT 1
